newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia states warn Canberra on funding cut.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia states warn Canberra on funding cut.

text.p: Australia's states warned Canberra on Friday they would resist any funding cuts above those already agreed to in the next budget.
The states have agreed to give up A$640 million in funding from Canberra in the national government's 1997/98 (July/June) budget, to be delivered on May 13.

State premiers said after a meeting in Melbourne on Friday they were concerned Treasurer Peter Costello would ask for additional savings from the states to compensate the government for a recent blowout in its budget outlook.

A communique issued after the meeting expressed concern "that the Commonwealth will use issues such as the shortfall in company tax revenue, caused by a Commonwealth oversight, to further squeeze states and territories..."
"The need for any state fiscal contribution in 1997/98...cannot be assessed without scrutiny of the Commonwealth's budget position," it added.

Costello revealed in January that a shortfall in company tax receipts had contributed to a worsening in the government's forecast budget deficit in 1996/97 by nearly A$3 billion to A$8.5 billion. -- Melbourne bureau 613-9286-1421
